apps.localizedDescription:
Ghostship for iPhone & Apple Vision Pro:

Run Ghostship on your iPhone and Apple Vision Pro — the full game with saves, the Ghostship enhancements menu, game controllers and a tunable touch layout, and on Vision Pro a stereoscopic 3D mode that puts the game on a world-locked panel floating in your room with real depth.

Built on Ghostship and libultraship, rendering natively on Metal — no translation layer. 100% vibe coded with lots of passion and attention to detail.

Ghostship on Apple Vision Pro — a resizable window floating in your room, with the on-screen touch layout. The same build also runs in stereoscopic 3D.

Texture Packs (strongly recommended):

The port supports Harbour Masters' .o2r mods, and the one worth installing is SM64 Reloaded by GhostlyDark — a UHD texture pack in two flavours.

versions.localizedDescription:
An iOS 27 compatibility and performance update. Your saves and extracted game data carry over unchanged; no re-extraction needed.

iPhone & iPad.

• Built with the iOS 27 SDK: launches correctly on iOS 27 and stays in landscape, including after returning from the Home screen or pulling down Control Center (no more stretched or sideways picture).
• The game no longer slows down under load: the game clock now keeps real time, so when a frame runs late the game and its music stay at full speed instead of dropping into slow motion.
• Lighter touch controls: the on-screen stick and Z button are drawn as separate layers, so moving the stick no longer redraws the whole overlay every frame.
• Drag-to-look: with the Manual camera (Enhancements > Camera > Default Camera Mode = Manual), swipe on empty screen space to turn the camera. Adjust it with Touch Camera Sensitivity in the iOS settings section. Invert and Camera Speed settings apply as usual.
• Always Show Menu Button: a new option in the iOS settings section that keeps the menu button on screen during gameplay.

Apple Vision Pro.

• Rebuilt from the same source. The pacing fix applies to the 2D window; the 3D mode is unchanged from 1.0.1. Verified on the visionOS simulator; this build was not tested in the headset.

This public build does not include the developer console.

Bring your own ROM; the app extracts it on device.
